title: The Trail Beside Mine Doesn't GLOW 👣
description:
Two trails of footprints run through this town, and only mine glows. Every footprint here glows until sunrise. One dawn, a trail that doesn't glow showed up beside mine. At Nana's orchard, my old prints never fade at all.

I came back for harvest week. Every dawn there was a new trail one stride from my path, huge square prints that didn't glow, and each morning they stopped a little nearer the house.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment GLOW if you'd want to see where you walked last night.
